B1: Why Villains Are Interesting

Quality checked lesson

Discover how villains work like alarms, mysteries, safe fears, and changing puzzles. Interest keeps us looking for the next answer; it is not praise.

🎭Word Help: Named Villains

WordSimple MeaningFlashcards
The masked villain in Star Wars, once a Jedi named Anakin Skywalker.

The villain in Shakespeare's play Othello, who tricks people by changing what they believe.

The being made in Mary Shelley's novel; he causes harm but also feels rejected and alone.

🔑Useful Topic Vocabulary

WordSimple MeaningFlashcards
A character who causes serious harm or works against the main character.

Something that may cause harm or danger.

The wish to know or learn something.

A reason why someone does something.

A strong disagreement or struggle, inside or between people.

Connected to ideas about right and wrong.

The feeling that something is far from your real life, so it feels safer to think about.

The state of sharing something with another person or character.

The nervous feeling of not knowing what will happen next.

Not clear; open to more than one meaning.
